_meta.description: Canonical class taxonomy for the NutriCare AI Food Scanner. One entry per model output class.
_meta.mapping_rule: 'food' names an entry that MUST exist in data/foods.json. 'nutrition_source':'unavailable' means no documented dataset entry exists, so the app must ask the user for values instead of inventing them.
_meta.multi_food_note: The classifier is single-label: it reports the single dominant dish in a photograph. It does not segment or separate multiple dishes on one plate.

merged_classes.why: Same rice preparation with minor tempering differences.
Lentil curries look alike; per-lentil distinction is not reliably learnable.

trained_model_coverage.note: Classes the shipped checkpoint can actually predict. Keep this in sync with models/food_classifier.pt via its 'classes' field.

provenance_notes.cc0_12_class: Classes added alongside models/food_classifier_cc0.pt (CC0 1.0 source). 'unavailable' nutrition_source rows exist on purpose: the classifier recognises the dish, but NutriCare has no documented nutrition entry, so the app asks the user instead of fabricating a figure.

classes.label: Masala Dosa
classes.approx_note: Nutrition uses the plain-dosa entry from the dataset. Masala dosa adds a potato filling and is typically higher in carbohydrate and fat; treat this estimate as a lower bound.

classes.label: Vegetable Biryani
classes.approx_note: The dataset has no separate vegetable-biryani entry. Vegetable pulao is used as the closest documented preparation; biryani usually has more oil and is often higher in energy.

classes.label: Pakora / Bhajji
classes.approx_note: Recipe-derived (approximate): besan + mixed vegetables deep-fried. Oil absorption and vegetable mix vary widely; treat as an estimate.
classes.notes: Recognised by the CC0 model. Nutrition is a recipe-derived estimate (see approx_note), not an IFCT/USDA entry for the dish.

classes.label: Pani Puri
classes.food: Pani puri (assembled, with filling and water)
classes.approx_note: Recipe-derived (approximate): fried semolina puris + potato/chana filling + tamarind-mint water. Values cover the assembled snack, not the puris alone.
classes.notes: Recognised by the CC0 model. Nutrition is a recipe-derived estimate for the assembled snack (see approx_note).

classes.label: Jalebi
classes.approx_note: Recipe-derived (approximate): maida batter fried in ghee and soaked in sugar syrup. Syrup absorption varies a lot between shops.
classes.notes: Recognised by the CC0 model. Nutrition is a recipe-derived estimate (see approx_note); sugar and ghee uptake vary widely.

classes.label: Kheer / Payesh (rice pudding)
classes.notes: Added with the CC0 12-class model. Row is flagged 'approximate': Indian kheer varies widely in sugar and milk fat.

classes.label: Rasgulla / Rosogolla
classes.notes: Added with the CC0 12-class model. Row flagged 'approximate'; based on typical values, not a lab measurement.

classes.label: Chomchom (chhena sweet)
classes.approx_note: Recipe-derived (approximate): chhena + sugar syrup. Sugar content varies by shop and soak time.
classes.notes: Recognised by the CC0 model. Nutrition is a recipe-derived estimate (see approx_note), not an IFCT/USDA entry for the sweet.

classes.label: Morog Polao (Bengali chicken pilaf)
classes.approx_note: Recipe-derived (approximate): rice + chicken + ghee. Deliberately NOT mapped to 'Pulao, vegetable', which is a different dish.
classes.notes: Recognised by the CC0 model. Deliberately NOT mapped to 'Pulao, vegetable' (a different dish) — nutrition is a recipe-derived estimate of this pilaf (see approx_note).

classes.label: Luchi (deep-fried bread)
classes.approx_note: Closest documented item: luchi and puri are both deep-fried maida/atta breads. Values differ by flour and oil uptake.
classes.notes: Not part of the CC0 12-class model (no Luchi folder in the source dataset); taxonomy entry only.

classes.label: Biryani
classes.approx_note: Biryani varies by region, meat, and preparation. Closest documented entry is Chicken biryani.
classes.notes: Recognised by the experimental 80-class model. Nutrition mapped to Chicken biryani (recipe-derived).

classes.label: Chapati / Phulka
classes.notes: Chapati and roti are the same whole-wheat flatbread; nutrition shared with roti entry.

classes.label: Chana Masala / Chole
classes.notes: Direct match with documented Chole / chana masala (prepared) entry.

classes.label: Cham Cham / Chomchom
classes.approx_note: Cham cham and chomchom are the same chhena-based sweet (regional spelling). Values vary by syrup soak.
classes.notes: Same sweet as chomchom; nutrition shared. Recipe-derived estimate.

classes.label: Kadhi Pakora
classes.notes: Direct match with documented Kadhi pakora (prepared) entry.

classes.label: Lassi
classes.notes: Direct match with documented Lassi, sweet (prepared) entry.

classes.label: Chak Hao Kheer
classes.approx_note: Chak hao is black rice from Manipur; mapped to regular rice kheer. Nutrition differs due to rice variety.
classes.notes: APPROXIMATE: mapped to Kheer, milk-rice as closest documented entry. Black rice vs white rice changes nutrition values.

classes.label: Doodhpak
classes.approx_note: Doodhpak is a Gujarati milk pudding similar to kheer but often thicker with nuts. Mapped to kheer as closest entry.
classes.notes: APPROXIMATE: mapped to Kheer, milk-rice as closest documented entry.

classes.label: Navrattan Korma
classes.approx_note: Navrattan korma is mixed vegetables in creamy cashew/yogurt sauce; mapped to mixed vegetable curry. Sauce differs (cream/cashew vs simple curry).
classes.notes: APPROXIMATE: mapped to Vegetable curry, mixed as closest documented entry.

classes.label: Phirni / Firni
classes.approx_note: Phirni is made with ground rice and served cold; mapped to kheer. Texture and rice preparation differ.
classes.notes: APPROXIMATE: mapped to Kheer, milk-rice as closest documented entry.
